stdout_count_definition: SearchUtils.cpp executeBatchLegacy prints session.queries.size after LoadAndPreprocessSpectra; Pipeline.cpp sums the same query-vector sizes across batches. These are engine-loaded queries, not original physical MS2 scans.
batch_limit_clarification: The frozen protocol describes at most 5000 spectra per batch. The implemented parameter is a loader stopping threshold. CometPreprocess.cpp samples the query-vector size before scheduling work, then waits for active workers after the stopping check; multiple queries and outstanding work can give a reported query count slightly above 5000. The observed 5005-query batch does not imply a different parameter or omitted input.

source_locations.CometPreprocess.cpp: query counter and queued jobs lines 915-985; threshold lines 2398-2404

analysis_rule: Report converted MS2 scans, loaded query totals, exported queries and physical scans with winners separately; never equate a missing exported assignment with proof of biological absence.
